screen.killstreakcod.instructions: Choose slot → choose reward → save. Independent progress and stock survive death.

killstreakcod.configuration.scorestreaks: Use score instead of kills. Changing modes retains earned rewards and resets incomplete progress.
killstreakcod.configuration.repeatableRe: Enabled: independent counters persist through death. Disabled: each reward is earned once per life; stock is retained.
killstreakcod.configuration.mgbEnabled.t: Allow earning, granting and activating MGB. Disabled by default; existing stock is retained.
killstreakcod.configuration.juggernautEn: Allow selecting, earning and using Juggernaut, including care packages. Disabled by default.
killstreakcod.configuration.originalRadi: Play the original English radio voices; also controlled by Minecraft's Voice/Speech volume.
killstreakcod.configuration.radioSubtitl: Show the actual line and speaker. English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese and Literary Chinese are provided; other locales use English.
Radio volume multiplier from 0 (silent) to 1 (full volume).
killstreakcod.configuration.effectSprite: Maximum live killstreak effect sprites, shared across all rewards (32–512).

research.killstreakcod.mode_hint: Survival requires research and prepaid reserves. Reaching the kill/score threshold spends one reserve and earns a callable reward. Killstreak mode needs no reserves; equipped upgrades work in both modes.

research.killstreakcod.navigation: Drag to pan; wheel to scroll; Shift + wheel to pan sideways.
research.killstreakcod.empty_category: This branch has no entries yet.
research.killstreakcod.terminal_descript: Upgrade the terminal in order to access higher-tier research. Progress belongs to you in this world.
research.killstreakcod.call_mode_hint: Killstreak mode earns rewards without reserves. Use the normal hotkeys to call them. Existing survival reserves are retained.
research.killstreakcod.terminal_maximum: Terminal IV is the highest tier.

Add a second airstrike pass from the departure direction, one second after the first pass leaves.
After designation and a tablet transition, control the first airstrike cannon with a Wheelson-style HUD.
Increase precision airstrike cannon damage by 50%.

Fire five shells per volley instead of three, concentrated within five blocks of the target.
Add another mortar volley, with one second between volleys.
If an open chamber exists within ten blocks below the impact point, penetrate the roof and strike it.
